caption: Treatment counterfactuals from the identical sepsis_cosim composite (severity 3, 2 h, delay 1 h). Untreated, early, and delayed treatment differ only in when the controller starts. Early treatment clears bacteremia (final 0.0057); delayed lets it accumulate first (0.16) then clears it; untreated climbs (11). Tissue integrity ends 1.000 early vs 0.983 untreated. The convergence panel runs the early arm at 240/120/60 s per tick: as the coupling step shrinks the final bacteremia changes by 0.0548, so the co-simulation is numerically consistent. This separates execution success (the coupling runs and converges) from pharmacological credibility (the PK is illustrative, not calibrated).
